title: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleRomaji: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleNative: 最強の剣聖、美少女メイドに転生し箒で無双する
synonyms: The strongest sword saint is reincarnated as a beautiful maid and becomes unrivaled with a broom
synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)

title: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra
titleRomaji: Isekai Mokushiroku Mynoghra: Hametsu no Bunmei de Hajimeru Sekai Seifuku
titleNative: 異世界黙示録マイノグーラ ～破滅の文明で始める世界征服～
synonyms: ไมนอกรา บันทึกวันอวสาน(ต่าง)โลก ~พิชิตใต้หล้าด้วยอารยธรรมเเห่งหายนะ~
synopsis: “I reincarnated as an evil god.” Takuto Ira, after dying from illness at a young age, is reborn into a world just like the strategy simulation game he loved in his past life, “Eternal Nations.” There, what appears before his eyes is a girl, Atou, whom he had used before in the evil civilization he previously subdued in the game, Mynoghra. The two resolve to create a new nation in this world once more. (Source: Yen Press)

title: You Can’t Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!

titleEnglish: You Can’t Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!

synonyms: No more love with the girls
Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai
소꿉친구와는 러브 코미디를 할 수 없어
synopsis: Eeyuu, a high school boy, has a problem! Two childhood friends "Shio" and "Akari" who go to the same high school are too cute! If they find out that I'm the only one looking sexually at them now that they've grown up, even though I have no intention of doing so... that would be too much! On the other hand, the two childhood friends also have their own secrets...? It's so awkward! It's complicated! But childhood friends are the best! A sweet and impatient love triangle love comedy where you can't be honest! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

synonyms: Let's Hang Out When the Black Plague is Over! ~A Slow Life of Modern Civilization in the World of Middle Age Europe~
synopsis: In 14th Century Middle Age Europe, the spread of the Black Plague has led baker Rachel Becker to move from the city to a village. There, she meets Ema Muller, a "witch" who claims to come from "another world" 700 years into the future, bringing with her modern technology that feels like "magic" to the people of the middle ages... (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Märchen Girl Runs!!!
titleNative: メルヘン・ガール・ランズ!!!
synopsis: The story begins with Snow White, who fell asleep after eating a poisonous apple, waking up in modern-day Japan. After wandering the streets of the city, she arrives at Kabukicho, where she is called out to by a woman named Karen. Karen also seems to come from a fairy tale world, just like Snow White, and the two hit it off. However, one day, after going to meet the "prince," Karen's behavior becomes strange... In order to return to her original world, Snow White unites with "princesses" from other worlds, such as Cinderella, and struggles to activate magic. (Source: Natalie, translated)
